controls: Close, with save prompt for unsaved work
workflow: Open a plain text file by passing its path after the executable. A new path starts an empty document.
Write, select with Shift+arrows or by dragging, and use the host clipboard. Notes supports ASCII text up to 4 KB.
Save with Command-S on Mac, Ctrl-S elsewhere, F2, or the Save button. Closing unsaved work offers Save, Discard and Cancel.

workflow: Start with the four-track demo or pass a saved .mlpat file to reopen a composition.
Choose a track, click the piano roll to place notes and use the overview lanes to jump to a step.
Play with Space, isolate a part with the mute buttons, and adjust tempo from 70 to 200 BPM.
Save the pattern to keep notes, mute states and tempo.

controls: Move pixel cursor and apply tool
workflow: Draw with pencil or erase, fill a connected color region, or right-click to pick a color.
Use the cursor keys and Enter to edit pixel by pixel without a mouse. The footer reports the exact pixel and opaque pixel count.
Compare the native-size and 2x previews, toggle grid and zoom, and flip the sprite with X or V.
Export writes a reusable ARGB C header atomically; transparent pixels stay transparent.

controls: Erase the tile under the cursor
workflow: Paint terrain and objects on the same map. Floor removes an object, while a goal can share its cell with a crate or player.
Validate before playtesting. The check catches open boundaries, missing players, unmatched goals and crates, isolated goals and static corner traps.
Enter or F5 starts an isolated playtest. Move with arrows or WASD, undo with U and reset with R. Escape returns to editing.
Save exports the original designed map, not the transient playtest board. Pass the same .mlmap path to reopen it later.
